Sandbox’25 TV Show Planning & Execution Report Milestone 1
Overview
The preparation for the Sandbox’25 TV Show has been progressing efficiently, with key milestones achieved across location selection, TV station partnerships, promotional brand engagements, and securing judges and mentors. This report provides an overview of these developments and supporting documentation.
Location Selection
After evaluating multiple locations, we have finalized a venue that aligns with our vision for the show. The chosen location ensures accessibility, high-quality production setup, and a dynamic environment for participants and stakeholders. ms.report:
Unified Cardano Student Club Report (Milestone 2)
Objective: To accelerate student-led blockchain solutions across Africa through Cardano-based training, mentorship, and a structured innovation pipeline.
🚀 Program Pipeline & Achievements
1. Application & Outreach
Overview:
・Open call launched with targeted promotional materials (posters, social media campaigns).
・Adjustments made to simplify registration after initial complexity, resulting in a 40% increase in applications.

Results:
・576 teams applied (comprising 3–5 members each), totaling over 1,000 participants (Project Managers, Developers, Designers).
・Applications received from 10+ universities in Nigeria, highlighting broad continental reach.

2. Selection Rounds
Round 1: Initial Shortlisting (100 Teams)
Selection Criteria:
・Balanced team composition (technical & non-technical roles).
・Clear problem-solution alignment, focused on African challenges.
・Bonus for Cardano Student Club affiliation.
・ Outcome: 100 teams advanced.

Round 2: Training & Pitch Preparation
4-Week Intensive Training:
・Workshops:
・Fridays: Interactive Q&A sessions.
・Weekends: Technical deep dives and pitch refinement.
・Mentorship: 1-on-1 mentoring for project development.

Final Round: Pitch Submissions (34 Teams)
Submission Requirements:
・Functional prototype (GitHub submission).
・Comprehensive pitch deck (problem, solution, market strategy, and feasibility).
・Workshop attendance of 50% or more.

Outcome: 34 teams successfully submitted final deliverables.
3. Final Selection: 25 Teams
Evaluation Criteria:
・Innovation/ Pitch Quality/ Team Commitment (60%) – Scalability and relevance to African market, Clarity, storytelling, and potential for impact.
・Technical Execution (20%) – GitHub contributions and prototype functionality.
・Workshop Participation (20%) – Participation rate and mentor engagement.

Outcome:
・25 finalist teams selected.
・5 virtual teams merged with others to ensure regional balance and team strength.
